A '''textfile''' was a type of [[Media/Legends|media]] that existed in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. Textfiles were essentially a type of document.

The New Republic document ''[[Why Do We Fight the Empire?]]'', which was produced by [[Mon Mothma/Legends|Mon Mothma]] in [[10 ABY/Legends|10 ABY]], was classified as a textfile.

[[Brollyx]], an [[Assistant-Viceprex]] of the [[Corporate Sector Authority/Legends|Corporate Sector Authority's]] [[Security Police/Legends|Security Police]], was given several textfiles by [[Hokkor Long]], the [[Secretary in Charge of Scheduling]] for the [[Imperial Entertainers' Guild]], when Brollyx sued the company for the destruction of [[Stars' End/Legends|Stars' End]].
